title: Find distinct female patients aged 50 or older who were admitted to the hos
question: Find distinct female patients aged 50 or older who were admitted to the hospital and have at least one laboratory record showing abnormal uric acid (UA > 6.5). Among these, include only those who also have—on any laboratory visit (not necessarily the same)—either (a) an abnormal red blood cell count (RBC ≤ 3.5 or RBC ≥ 6.0), or (b) a lab record with elevated blood glucose (GLU ≥ 180) and normal total cholesterol (T-CHO < 250). Return their ID, admission status, and a flag indicating they meet all criteria.

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    E."XCL_013" AS admission_status,
    1 AS meets_all_criteria
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND E."XCL_013" > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L1
    WHERE L1."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058" AND L1."XCL_022" > 6.5
  )
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L2
      WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND (L2."XCL_021" <= 3.5 OR L2."XCL_021" >= 6.0)
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L3
      WHERE L3."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND L3."XCL_029" >= 180
        AND L3."XCL_026" < 250
    )
  )

Among these, include only those who also have—on any laboratory visit (not necessarily the same)—either (a) an abnormal red blood cell count (RBC ≤ 3.5 or RBC ≥ 6.0), or (b) a lab record with elevated blood glucose (GLU ≥ 180) and normal total cholesterol (T-CHO < 250). Return their ID, admission status, and a flag indicating they meet all criteria.

SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    E."XCL_013" AS admission_status,
    1 AS meets_all_criteria
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND E."XCL_013" > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L1
    WHERE L1."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058" AND L1."XCL_022" > 6.5
  )
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L2
      WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND (L2."XCL_021" <= 3.5 OR L2."XCL_021" >= 6.0)
    )
    OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L3
      WHERE L3."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND L3."XCL_029" >= 180
        AND L3."XCL_026" < 250
    )
  )
